evidence.quote: ZARYS was founded in 1989 in Zabrze, where its main headquarters, modern Logistics Center, and production line for dedicated surgical packs and procedure sets are still located today || We have already established our own branches in the Czech Republic, Romania, Portugal, Italy, Hungary and Dubai where we also have a warehouse || a reliable partner for hospitals, doctors, and medical facilities
